description: This file contains the implementation of the OrleansSiloInstanceManager class, which manages silo instances in an Azure Table Storage backend within Orleans Cluster. It includes methods for managing silo entries, querying gateway endpoints, and handling table entries' lifecycle.

classes.name: OrleansSiloInstanceManager
classes.description: Manages silo instances stored within Azure Table Storage for Orleans clusters, providing lifecycle management, querying, and consistency operations.

methods.name: GetManager
methods.description: Factory method to initialize and retrieve an OrleansSiloInstanceManager instance, including Azure table initialization.

methods.name: CreateTableVersionEntry
methods.description: Creates a new table entry representing the current deployment version.

methods.name: RegisterSiloInstance
methods.description: Registers a silo instance in Azure Table Storage by upserting its entry.

methods.name: UnregisterSiloInstance
methods.description: Marks a silo instance as dead/unregistered in the table storage.

methods.name: ActivateSiloInstance
methods.description: Marks a silo instance as active in the table storage.

methods.name: FindAllGatewayProxyEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves all gateway proxy endpoints for active silos in the deployment.

methods.name: DumpSiloInstanceTable
methods.description: Returns a string representation of all silo entries for debugging or diagnostics.

methods.name: MergeTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Merges an update into an existing table entry.

methods.name: ReadSingleTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Reads a single table entry identified by partition and row key.

methods.name: DeleteTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all silo entries for a given cluster ID.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes silo entries that are outdated and no longer active.

methods.name: TryCreateTableVersionEntryAsync
methods.description: Attempts to create a new version entry in the table if it does not already exist.

methods.name: InsertSiloEntryConditionally
methods.description: Inserts a new silo entry conditionally, based on ETag matching.

methods.name: UpdateSiloEntryConditionally
methods.description: Updates a silo entry conditionally, based on ETag matching.
